body.name: strictly positive nonattainment witness
body.construction: Let \(X\) be absent, \(U^\star\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(1/2)\), \(P^\star(A=1\mid U^\star=u)=(1+2u)/4\), and let \(Z,W\in\{0,1,2\}\) be conditionally independent given \(U^\star\), each with probability vector \((3/5,3/10,1/10)\) at \(U^\star=0\) and \((1/10,3/10,3/5)\) at \(U^\star=1\). Given \((A,U^\star)\), let \(Y\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(1/5+A/5+2U^\star/5)\), conditionally independent of \((Z,W)\). The observed marginal law is \(P^\star\).
